_note: Editable assumptions for CareSignal's ILLUSTRATIVE cost estimates (npm run tokenomics). These are not bills. Change any number and re-run to see the effect. Measured usage is reported separately and is never changed by this file.

pricing.source: Assumption, not a verified price. Stand-in values equal to OpenAI's published GPT-5 API list price as remembered from its August 2025 launch (US$1.25 per 1M input tokens, US$0.125 per 1M cached input tokens, US$10 per 1M output tokens). No price for gpt-6-luna, for the course's Portkey account, or for any discount could be verified.

categorize.basis: Measured average of 35 categorization calls in the 2026-10-26 evaluation run (docs/evaluation/results.json).

insights.basis: Measured average of 4 insight calls in the same run. Output includes the model's reasoning tokens, which are billed as output.

usageNotes.observationsPerUserPerMonth: About 10 notes a week from an active caregiver.
usageNotes.insightRequestsPerUserPerMonth: About one 'Generate AI analysis' per week.
usageNotes.insightCacheHitShare: Share of insight requests answered from a saved run because the notes had not changed (no AI call).
usageNotes.handoffDraftsNeedingNewAiCall: Share of weekly handoff drafts that need a new insight call; the rest reuse a validated run for the same notes.
usageNotes.retryRate: Extra calls from failed requests that are retried (timeouts, rejected output).
